concerns.text: Task T047 (Structural Validator) enforces Pauling constraints (peptide planarity, H-bond topology) but no corresponding FR or SC exists in spec.md. The spec limits scope to 'HOMO, LUMO, and Mayer descriptors' and 'experimental barrier dataset' without mandating geometric constraint validation.

Task T048 (Ontology Mapper) tags descriptors as 'Observable' vs 'Computational Artifact' to address Einstein's concern, but spec.md contains no FR/SC requiring this ontological classification or 'map vs. territory' distinction in the output.

Task T049 (Feynman Diagram Tracer) traces predictions to electron density paths, but spec.md FR-002/US1 only requires descriptor extraction. No FR/SC mandates path-integral tracing or Feynman review compliance in the implementation.

Task T050 (Hydration Shell Model) adds solvent parameters to DFT calculations, but spec.md FR-003/US2 only mandates 'B3LYP/def2-SVP calculations on a subset' without requiring explicit hydration shell modeling or Franklin review compliance.

Task T051 (Resource Budget) estimates FLOPs and cites Dyson, but spec.md FR-005/FR-008 only require MAE computation and threshold flags. No FR/SC mandates a 'Resource Budget' paragraph or FLOP estimation in the deliverables.

Task T043 (Missing Degrees of Freedom) quantifies physical information lost, but spec.md FR-005/FR-008 only require MAE and a 20% flag. No FR/SC mandates a 'physical model of missing terms' or Dyson review metric.

Task T025 requires calculating a 'speedup ratio' and flagging failure if <10x, but spec.md contains no FR/SC defining a speedup target (e.g., '10x faster'). This introduces an arbitrary constraint not traceable to the spec.

Task T052 (Physical Constraints Validation) documents geometric constraints against crystallographic data, but spec.md has no FR/SC requiring this specific validation report or Pauling review documentation in the final output.

Task T016 sets a hard OOM kill limit at 'RSS > 6.5GB', but Constitution Principle VII sets the constraint at '≤ 7 GB RAM'. The task defines a specific implementation threshold (6.5GB) that contradicts the constitutional limit (7GB) without explaining the safety margin, creating a traceability gap.

Task T020 specifies 'min 30 molecules' for the DFT subset, but spec.md FR-003/US2 only says 'a subset'. The specific number '30' is an arbitrary implementation detail not traceable to the spec, risking violation if data availability is lower.
